reviewer_item: NHSJS Must Fix 3: rescore the fine-tuned RDT-1B PickCube vision curves (15 successes in 60 episodes) with the same procedure; report successful and unsuccessful episodes separately
question: Within each saved RDT-1B PickCube curve, how much does changing only the response from Q to stabilized N change saved-grid normalized AUC, separately for successful and unsuccessful recorded episodes?
pre_outcome_knowledge: Before this protocol, only file structure was read: record counts, duplicate keys, own-sidecar fingerprints, success labels and calls per episode (notes Month 9/9.2 sections 3 and 4). No paired difference was computed on these files.

runs.documented_language_input: Month 4 run (2026-05-26): the RDT authors' precomputed PickCube instruction embedding and a zeroed placeholder language baseline (notes Month 4/4.6, Month 6/6.2, TMLR errata D13)
Month 6 run (2026-06-14): pod-generated T5-XXL instruction embedding and the encoded PAD/EOS language baseline (notes Month 6/6.2, 6.3)
Month 6 run (2026-06-14): pod-generated T5-XXL instruction embedding and the encoded PAD/EOS language baseline (notes Month 6/6.2, 6.3)
Month 5 reproduction of seed 42 on another machine with real T5-XXL instruction embeddings and the encoded baseline (notes Month 5/5.7, Month 6/6.2)

native_scale_rule: Saved curves are Q-scored (historical logpi target), Q = -r/(2*512); r = -2*512*Q. Every stored vision and language f_input must equal 0, otherwise the run fails.
occurrence_rule: last physical occurrence of each key within its source file (analysis.revision.core.reconcile); the conflict-excluded membership comparison is recorded
own_sidecar_fingerprint: Join each faithfulness row to its run's step row on (task, model, seed, episode, policy_call_idx). For vision and language, original form: abs(-step_gap - f_baseline) <= 1e-6*max(abs(step_gap), abs(f_baseline), 1e-12); general form: the same test of step_gap against f_input - f_baseline. Every row of every run must join and agree in both forms, otherwise the analysis fails.
success_label: The boolean success field of the run's own episode_end row joined on (task, model, seed, episode). Every saved episode needs exactly one such row, contiguous policy calls 0..n-1, and episode_end policy_calls equal to its saved call count.
rescoring: analysis.paired_rescoring.analyze.paired_curve(k_grid_auc, curve, f_input, f_baseline, 'Q', dimension=512, epsilon=1e-12) per saved curve; Delta = AUC_Q - AUC_N on the same saved nodes and endpoints; positive Delta means scoring with N lowers that AUC. Geometry labels, in-range/overshoot/undershoot node contributions and the generalized identity check are those of the frozen paired analysis.
language_policy: Language is summarized per run only and never pooled: the seed-42 language baseline was zeroed while seeds 142 and 242 used encoded baselines (TMLR errata D13). Vision uses the gray-image baseline in every run. pooled_primary is the primary vision population; m5_seed42 is a sensitivity population and is never pooled with the primary runs.

statistics.counts: n_raw_calls, n_defined_calls, n_undefined_calls, n_raw_episodes, n_defined_episodes, calls_per_episode_min/max; call counts are reported for every row because successful episodes are short
statistics.paired_median: median of defined call Delta values (equal call weight), with its whole-episode bootstrap interval
statistics.positive_share: defined calls with Delta > 0 divided by defined calls; negative and zero counts also reported
statistics.overshoot_share: calls with at least one saved ordinate whose squared residual exceeds both endpoint residuals, divided by raw calls
statistics.fully_in_range_share: defined calls with no overshoot and no undershoot ordinate, divided by defined calls; positive calls among them and among overshoot calls are also counted
statistics.min_max: minimum and maximum defined call Delta
statistics.equal_call_mean: math.fsum mean of defined call Delta values (descriptive; differs from the equal-episode mean when episode lengths differ)
statistics.equal_episode_mean: math.fsum mean over defined episodes of the within-episode math.fsum mean Delta, with its whole-episode bootstrap interval
statistics.contributions: equal-episode means of the within-episode mean trapezoid contributions of in-range, high-distance overshoot and low-distance undershoot nodes; they sum to the equal-episode mean (checked to 1e-9 relative)
statistics.episode_level: median of within-episode mean Delta; count and share of episodes with a positive mean; count and share of episodes with any overshoot call; count and share of episodes whose calls are all fully in range; min and max episode mean
statistics.first_versus_later: first means policy_call_idx 0, later means policy_call_idx > 0. For each: raw and defined calls, median, equal-call mean, min, max, positive share, overshoot calls and share, fully-in-range share, and contributions to the equal-episode mean using the whole population's weights 1/(E*n_e), so first plus later equals the equal-episode mean

bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng PCG64, integers(0, G, size=(block, G)) in blocks of at most 128 draws, the index stream of analysis.revision.core.bootstrap_summary
bootstrap.unit: whole recorded episode within the summarized population and outcome group, unstratified by run; all defined calls of a selected episode stay together
bootstrap.median_draw: median of all resampled defined calls with multiplicity
bootstrap.mean_draw: math.fsum mean of the resampled within-episode means
bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles, numpy linear method reproduced in pure Python
bootstrap.status: fewer than 2 episodes gives no interval (insufficient_groups); exactly 2 is two_group_descriptive_only; otherwise conditional_empirical_episode_percentile
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive conditional intervals over recorded episodes; no multiplicity adjustment, calibration or significance claim

undefined_policy: A zero endpoint gap in either response leaves the paired effect undefined; such calls stay in raw counts and are excluded only from defined-call statistics. Nonfinite or malformed values fail. No clipping, trimming or substitution.

outputs.inputs.json: anchor verification, per-file authentication and stored-arithmetic checks, duplicate handling, per-run fingerprint, success roster and documented language input
outputs.calls.csv.gz: one row per saved call, modality and direction with Delta, AUCs, endpoint residuals, maximum interior residual, node labels counts and contributions
outputs.episodes.csv: one row per run, case and recorded episode
outputs.summary.csv: one row per population, case and outcome group
outputs.call_index.csv: first versus later calls per population, case and outcome group
outputs.provenance.json: protocol, source, input and artifact SHA-256 hashes (gzip artifacts also hash their decompressed payload) and the environment

scope_limits: Response-only rescoring of fixed saved rankings; no ranking efficacy, task-success causality or model comparison
Success and failure groups differ in episode length and in every unmeasured property of their contexts; their summaries are not a controlled contrast
The historical nominal percentage grid is retained; realized masks are not preserved with these curves
Checkpoint, observation, noise and reference action tensors remain unauthenticated; recorded episodes are not independently randomized units
Language baselines differ across runs; no cross-run language pooling or comparison is made
